name: pam_ssh_limit_ip
detailed_description: PAM module to restrict SSH access based on source IP addresses. Implements IP whitelisting/blacklisting for SSH login attempts at PAM level.
notes:
Lightweight IP filtering at PAM level. Can reduce SSH attack surface.
